title: Old Quebec City Private Walking Tour : History and Nature
includes: A new experience of history learning about its relation with geography and climate.
Quebec History in relation to world events from the XVI century and beyond.
Quebec and Canada History with a knowledgeable local guide
The tour covers the upper and lower town historical district.
Not recommended for people with mobility issues (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Welcome history buffs and nature enthusiasts! This Tour brings a new experience of History: walking through UNESCO site, the Tour describes historical facts in relation to world events leading the Europeans to settle in Quebec and North America. In addition to major historical events, the tour highlights how nature, climate and geography, affects culture and transform history. While discovering the oldest part of Quebec City, your guide highlights the multiple adaptations required to a sub arctic climate in architecture, in people's life and on urban setting. In addition to history, the tour illustrates the current realities in Quebec's economy and politic.
